key_point: Rocket League failed the first time
title: Rocket League failed the first time
caption: Rocket League is a second try: its 2008 predecessor, Battle-Cars, flopped. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #rocketleague #psyonix

instagram.caption:
In 2008 Psyonix made a PS3 game where rocket cars play soccer. It had the worst name possible: Supersonic Acrobatic Rocket-Powered Battle-Cars.

It found a small loyal crowd but no success. The studio survived on contract work for other games.

Seven years later they tried again as Rocket League. It launched on PS Plus and exploded into one of the biggest multiplayer games around.
